result.note: A scheduled visit with no outcomes yet. One question tests which country's leader was due to visit, with diamond and port links to Mumbai as the clue.

questions.prompt: In September 2026, the Prime Minister of which European country was scheduled to visit India from 2 to 4 September, and to meet stakeholders in Mumbai's diamond, ports and logistics sectors?
questions.explain: Belgian Prime Minister Bart De Wever was due to visit India from 2 to 4 September 2026. It was his first trip since taking office in February 2025, and Defence Minister Theo Francken was to accompany him. He was also to give a keynote at a CII business event linked to the India-European Union Free Trade Agreement.
questions.source: Belgian Prime Minister Bart De Wever will visit India from September 2 to 4, 2026, his first trip since taking office in February 2025, and will be accompanied by Defence Minister Theo Francken.
